title: The text API gained range and breathing room
summary:
More ways to make things: expanded text models, larger default images, and a rebuilt place to explore them.

Claude Hybridspace, Qwen Coder, and DeepSeek Reasoner joined the text API, while `llamalight` and `llama` moved to new Llama versions. The rate limit rose from 40 to 200 requests per minute, and the 56,000-character input check was removed. OpenRouter routing and error handling also changed, and a Realistic persona added an option for advice grounded in practical constraints.

Images requested without dimensions now default to 1024×1024, with a matching Flux Schnell generation path through Cloudflare Workers AI. Prompt sanitization now preserves Persian and other non-Latin characters. Unity also adjusted its image instructions to return raw URLs, request enhancement, and use the current user's preferred aesthetic for selfies. The image changes reduced maximum side lengths for Flux and Turbo and removed four models.

A responsive homepage rebuild refreshed the image feed and editor, integration examples, project listings, text transformations, and community sections. Public image-prompt redirects and site routing were restored in a follow-up. Earlier in the week, the homepage and README also gained links to a book of more than 90 generated artistic styles and a community Node.js package.
